summary: Wrote a 3-phase plan adopting the research report's Option 1: a self-contained, conservative awk heredoc-body stripper inside validate-bounded-waiter.sh, feeding the three-leg conjunction unchanged, bailing to the unstripped command on anything it cannot parse confidently. Phase 1 lands the stripper, the header decision record, and 8 new fixtures as an atomic batch; Phase 2 adds a Write/Edit hint to the refusal message on the bail path only; Phase 3 redeploys and runs the full gate set. Options 2 and 3 are rejected with reasoning recorded in the plan and destined for the hook's own header; no shared library is introduced and the conjunction's own regexes are untouched.

artifacts.summary: 3-phase plan: heredoc-aware stripper plus fixtures, bail-path refusal hint, redeploy and full gate.
